name: NoTrack API
description: A single-model hosted text API with a first-key trial.
overview: NoTrack advertises $0.50 on the first API key, valid seven days, and describes an account with a nickname and password. Card requirement for the trial is not explicit. The operator does not publish the underlying model identity. No account or inference was tested.
free_access: 300 requests/min and 8 parallel requests per key advertised
notes: Base URL https://api.notrack.ai/v1. Paid top-ups are separate; identity unverified.
